actors.name: Nurse Karolina
actors.private_context: Karolina wants someone to take her Sunday night shift. She has posted a request in the ward's swap channel. She will not be available to swap herself after the rota locks.

actors.name: Colleagues in the ward
actors.private_context: The colleagues are nurses who can see the swap channel. Some may be interested in picking up an extra shift for pay or flexibility, but none have a prior commitment to take this shift.

shared_context: The ward has a swap channel where nurses can post shift exchange requests. The rota locks on Friday at 15:00, after which no changes are possible. Karolina's post is visible to all colleagues in the channel.

starting_events.description: Nurse Karolina posts a request in the ward's swap channel asking someone to take her Sunday night shift.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that a colleague claimed the shift (e.g., by posting a reply or using the swap system) before the rota locks at 2026-08-14T15:00:00+02:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
